data.title: 帕瓦 · 喵子怀抱中的恶魔狂言
data.action: 毫无防备地大字型躺在被褥上，红角在乱糟糟的金发里高高翘起，怀里搂着喵子，一边打哈欠一边得意洋洋地冲你咧嘴大笑。
data.location: 早川家狭小的榻榻米卧室，地板上散落着漫画书、可乐空罐与猫粮碗
data.lighting: 晨光透过微开的窗帘直直切入室内，照亮空气中漂浮的细微尘粒与金灿灿的乱发
data.mood: 魔人的混沌野性与毫无戒备的憨态，搞笑又极度吸睛
data.description: 早川家狭小的榻榻米卧室，地板上散落着漫画书、可乐空罐与猫粮碗。毫无防备地大字型躺在被褥上，红角在乱糟糟的金发里高高翘起，怀里搂着喵子，一边打哈欠一边得意洋洋地冲你咧嘴大笑。 她微微抬眸轻语——“哇哈哈哈哈！本大爷无论穿什么都是世界上最华丽最伟大的！人类，快去给本大爷拿肉来！”
data.promptProse: Sprawled freely across a messy futon on the tatami floor on Sunday morning, Power wears a bold crimson stretch-cotton athletic tube top and relaxed claw-print boyshorts. Surrounded by scattered manga, empty soda cans, and a cat dish, she flashes a proud, bratty fanged grin under bright shafts of morning sun.
data.animaCaption: Sprawled unabashedly across a rumpled tatami futon in a crimson cotton tube top and matching boyshorts, she flashes a smug, fanged grin amid scattered manga, empty soda cans, and a cat food dish. Bright Sunday morning sunbeams stream through parted curtains.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a vibrant crimson stretch-cotton athletic tube top and matching relaxed boyshorts patterned with playful claw marks.
